title: Restriction of scalars for sheaves of modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\varphi:\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ a morphism of sheaves of rings on $\mathcal C$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O'$-modules $\mathcal M$, its *restriction of scalars* $\varphi_*\mathcal M$ is the same sheaf of abelian groups with $\mathcal O(U)$ acting on $\mathcal M(U)$ through $\varphi_U:\mathcal O(U)\to\mathcal O'(U)$ for every object $U$; this is a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules, and the construction is an additive functor from $\mathcal O'$-modules to $\mathcal O$-modules. In particular $\mathcal O'$ itself is an $\mathcal O$-module.

source.place: last sentence (the constant $B_Y$-module regarded as an $A_Y$-module); the notion is standard and has no dedicated statement in literature/stacks-project/sites-modules.tex (searched); the Mathlib declaration is the reference
